author: guitargeek
body:
Commit 349f19c3b89 ("Add additional info to the simTrack", #46979, first released in CMSSW_15_0_0_pre2) introduced the SimTrack primary flag and made genpartIndex() return -1, and noGenpart() return true, for tracks that are not flagged primary. Only the Geant4 simulation was updated to set the flag, so FastSim SimTracks and the TrackingParticles built from them lost the link to their generator particle.

Set the flag wherever FastSim creates a SimTrack with a generator particle index: in both FSimTrack constructors and in fastsim::ParticleManager::addSimTrack.

I noticed this when running some validation on my macOS port of CMSSW.
title: Mark FastSim SimTracks of generator particles as primary
